The middle shelf is the focal point of the image, featuring a gray and white cat nestled among folded clothes. The cat is partially covered by a dark leather jacket and a stack of blue jeans, which are neatly folded and stacked on top of each other. The cat's head and front paws are visible, and it looks directly at the camera with a calm expression.
